rules.coverage_text: Applies to all residential rentals in Massachusetts municipalities, limiting local rent control.

key_values.name: voluntary_compliance_after
key_values.text: after six months from the date of the initial adoption

key_values.name: min_owner_units
key_values.text: owned by a person or entity owning less than ten rental units

rules.quote: No city or town may enact, maintain or enforce rent control of any kind, except that any city or town that accepts this chapter may adopt rent control regulation that provides:
relations_hint: No city or town may enact, maintain or enforce rent control of any kind, except that any city or town that accepts this chapter may adopt rent control regulation
rules.requirement: Cities and towns may not enact, maintain or enforce rent control, except a city or town that accepts the chapter may adopt regulation meeting the section's conditions. Conditions include voluntary compliance after six months, no regulation of occupancy, services, evictions or condo conversion, no application to owners of fewer than ten rental units or units with fair market rent above $400, and municipal compensation of owners.
rules.title: General prohibition on rent control; limited exception
